title: Nolan Ryan on his four-seam and two-seam
lede: Ryan in his own words on the two fastballs. The four-seam stays true and rides up on the hitter; the two-seam runs in on a righty and away from a lefty. It's the exact four/two split these specimen pages are built on, taught by the man who threw it.
author: @bsf_pitchingperformance

clip.author: @bsf_pitchingperformance
clip.caption: Nolan Ryan didn't just throw gas — he understood movement. His breakdown of why the 4-seam plays up, and why the 2-seam is deadly running in on a right-handed hitter / away from a lefty.
